title: A contract that hard-codes the learner
description: Negative fixture for FR-P3-NO-LITERALS. This is defect F03: the constraint below is written for a nine-year-old, so the contract cannot serve a different learner without being edited. Who the learner is belongs in policy/calibration.v1.yaml, which the caps are derived from.

component_job.description: The component's main job in one sentence a nine-year-old can repeat.
